descricao.pt: Comentários brasileiros do Instagram anotados por especialistas para detecção de discurso de ódio e linguagem ofensiva.
descricao.en: Brazilian Instagram comments annotated by experts for hate speech and offensive language detection.

fontes.trecho: HateBR is the first large-scale, expert-annotated dataset of Brazilian Instagram comments specifically designed for hate speech detection on the web and social media
